name: personal-university-planner
description: Production implementation of the Personal University Planning System.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @university-planner/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck -w @university-planner/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && node --test tests/planner.test.js tests/analytics.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:boundaries && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
